zh: 交换两个同色球没有意义，所以红球之间的相对顺序不会改变，第 i 个红球最终落在连续段的第 i 个位置；每次有效的交换恰好让一个红球移动一格。
设第 i 个红球原位置为 p[i]，目标为 start+i，总步数是所有 |p[i]−i−start| 之和。令 b[i]=p[i]−i，问题变成选一个 start 使它到所有 b[i] 的距离和最小，即取中位数。
扫描字符串，对每个 R 记录“当前下标减去之前已见的红球数”，这个序列天然非降；没有红球时答案为 0。取它的中位数，累加每一项与中位数之差的绝对值；结果超过 10^9 时输出 −1。累加和可能超出 32 位。
en: Swapping two balls of the same color is pointless, so the red balls keep their relative order and the i-th red ball ends at the i-th cell of the block; each useful swap moves one red ball by exactly one cell.

If the i-th red ball starts at p[i] and ends at start+i, the total number of swaps is the sum of |p[i]−i−start|. With b[i]=p[i]−i, choose start to minimize the total distance to all b[i]: take the median.

Scan the string and, for each R, record its index minus the number of red balls seen before it; this sequence is already non-decreasing. With no red ball the answer is 0. Take the median and sum the absolute differences from it; print −1 if the sum exceeds 10^9. The sum may exceed 32-bit range.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The original positions p[i] of the red balls keep their relative order and move to the consecutive positions start+i; let b[i]=p[i]−i, minimize the sum of absolute distances to a common start, and take the median.

## Correctness

Balls of the same color never need to be swapped with each other, and matching the target positions in the original order avoids crossings. Each adjacent red-white swap moves one red ball by one step, so the total cost is exactly the sum of displacements; the sum of absolute distances is minimized at the median. b is already non-decreasing, so the median can be read off directly.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(N).
